sources.label: Appendix D.1 real Hilbert conventions and positive square-root background; B.10-B.11 actual all-macro square-root prerequisite, attributed ASTIS complexification completion, not a printed paper theorem.
sources.scope: No root, real descent of complex CFC root, uniqueness, Gamma0/B15/B16, weakH1/dynamics/main/error/querycost/composition, paper or Goal closure.

assumptions: Let E be a finite-dimensional real Hilbert Borel space with canonical volume, including the explicit rank-zero extension. Let V:E→ℝ be C², let 0<α≤β, and assume α‖v‖²≤D²V(x)[v,v]≤β‖v‖² for every x,v. Assume η>0 and βη≤1. Define μ(dx) proportional to exp(−V(x))dx, J as the law of (X,X+√η Z) for independent X∼μ,Z∼N(0,I), ν=J.snd, and Λ as the law of (Y,2X−Y) under J.
All kernel, probability, T and D certificates are conclusions. Finite E does not imply finite L2; rank-zero E and αη=1 are explicitly retained.
Pointwise conjugation C is real linear; it is distinct from operator adjoint. Complex-root preservation and descent remain separate obligations.
units.statement: Let E be a finite-dimensional real Hilbert Borel space with canonical volume, including the explicit rank-zero extension. Let V:E→ℝ be C², let 0<α≤β, and assume α‖v‖²≤D²V(x)[v,v]≤β‖v‖² for every x,v. Assume η>0 and βη≤1. Define μ(dx) proportional to exp(−V(x))dx, J as the law of (X,X+√η Z) for independent X∼μ,Z∼N(0,I), ν=J.snd, and Λ as the law of (Y,2X−Y) under J. The laws μ,J,ν are probabilities. There exists a Markov kernel S with, for every y, S(y)=volume.tilted(x↦−V((y+x)/2)−‖y−x‖²/(8η)), Λ.IsCondKernel S, Λ.fst=ν and Λ.snd=ν. There exists a selfadjoint bounded T on L²(ν;ℝ) such that for every u, ‖Tu‖≤‖u‖, Tu(y)=∫u(x)S(y,dx) ν-almost everywhere, and ∫Tu dν=∫u dν. Set D=I−T²; this exact full-domain squared defect is positive. Define the actual quotient maps ιu=u+0i, Rg=Re g, Qg=Im g and Cg=conj(g). Then ι preserves norm, Cg=g iff g=ιu for some real u, and there exists a bounded complex-linear positive Dc on L²(ν;ℂ) such that Dc g=ιD(Rg)+iιD(Qg), Dc(ιu)=ι(Du), and C(Dc g)=Dc(Cg), universally on their displayed domains. The operator T, positivity, kernel/law certificates and Dc are produced conclusions. No real Γ/root/descent/inverse is asserted.
units.formula: D=I-T^2\ge0\text{ on actual }L^2(\nu;\mathbb R),\quad D_{\mathbb C}g=\iota D(\operatorname{Re}g)+i\iota D(\operatorname{Im}g),\quad D_{\mathbb C}\ge0,\quad D_{\mathbb C}\iota=\iota D,\quad CD_{\mathbb C}=D_{\mathbb C}C.

steps.title: Produce the actual stationary operator
steps.text: Invoke the independently verified centered-defect producer under exactly the displayed potential and step assumptions. It supplies the probability laws, a Markov kernel S with the every-state normalized reflection density, Λ.IsCondKernel S, both stationary marginals, and the same selfadjoint contraction T with its AE conditional-integral action and preserved mean. These are conclusions, not caller certificates.

steps.title: Use the produced positive defect
steps.text: The same producer proves D=I−T² positive on the full real L²(ν), even though it vanishes on the constant class. Apply the canonical complexification theorem to this D and the actual ν. The resulting embedding, fixed range and complex operator have exactly the displayed formulas; no new positivity or CFC premise is introduced.
steps.formula: D=I-T^2\ge0,\quad D_{\mathbb C}g=\iota D(Rg)+i\iota D(Qg),\quad D_{\mathbb C}\iota=\iota D,\quad CD_{\mathbb C}=D_{\mathbb C}C.

steps.title: Keep the next theorem boundary explicit
steps.text: This constructs the genuine complex lift needed for a positive-root route. It does not construct the real Γ, prove that a complex root preserves Fix(C), descend that root, establish B.11, or supply centered inverse/polar/dynamics/error/cost conclusions. A separate test of the complex CFC API, if compiled, remains only a complex-root interface check.
steps.formula: \text{complex positive lift}\longrightarrow\text{pending real-root preservation and descent}.
